simple.summary: בְּאֵרוֹת (Bᵉʼêrôwth) means Beeroth , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 4 2.

definitions.full: H881. Beeroth בְאֵרוֺת proper name, of a location (but only 2Sam 4:2 according to Masora, see BD Ezra 2:23 elsewhere בְּאֵרֹת ), city of the Gibeonites Josh 9:17 ; assigned to Benjamin 2Sam 4:2 ; Josh 18:25 ; compare also Ezra 2:25 ; Neh 7:29 ; modern el-Bîreh Rob BR i. 452 Bd Pal 214 Survey iii. 88 .
